subject: Resale commissioning: catalog ownership, commissions & co-sell ops
messages:
From: Julia Myers <julia@marketway.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Resale commissioning + Marketplace listing questions

Hi Ben (and Laura),

Thanks again for the demo last week — MarketWay is excited about including Redwood in our reseller program and co-sell catalogue. Before we kick off the listing, Legal and Partner Ops asked for a couple of clarifications so we can scope the onboarding work: 

- Revenue share tiers you support (standard, enterprise, strategic) and whether you can cap minimums per deal.
- Which Redwood team is owning the marketplace listing content (logo, description, tech tags) vs. our partner ops taking the lead.
- Support handoff expectations: when a ticket comes from the marketplace, do you expect MarketWay to own first-line, or do you want direct routing to Redwood CS?
- Any required evidence for catalog certification (architecture diagram, SOC-2 stamp, AMI/container scan report).

I've attached MarketWay_CoSell_Reqs.pdf which lists our standard fields for listings and required artifacts. Can we do a 30-minute ops sync this week to align and capture a mutual action plan?

Thanks,
Julia
Julia Myers
Head of Partnerships | MarketWay
attachment: MarketWay_CoSell_Reqs.pdf (PDF)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julia Myers <julia@marketway.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Resale commissioning + Marketplace listing questions

Hi Julia — great to hear, and thanks for the doc. Quick answers and a proposed next step: 

- Revenue share: we typically offer a tiered revshare (10% / 15% / 20%) depending on ACV commitments and co-marketing. We can be flexible for strategic deals and support a capped minimum. We will send a term sheet with specific thresholds.
- Catalog ownership: Redwood prefers to own the technical copy (integration details, architecture diagram, security artifacts) while MarketWay controls the GTM-facing blurb and pricing commitments. We can mirror the content for both catalogs but need one canonical source of truth.
- Support handoff: standard is MarketWay first-line triage; high-severity incidents route to our on-call CS. We can define SLAs in the onboarding playbook.
- Certification artifacts: SOC 2 attestation + architecture diagram + short security questionnaire suffice for initial certification.

I'll attach a draft term sheet and a quick checklist for catalog items so we can review on a call. 30 minutes sounds good — are you available Tue 11/30 10:00am PT or Wed 12/1 2:00pm PT?

Best,
Ben Carter
Director, Alliances | Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
attachment: RW_CoSell_TermSheet_v1.docx (Word)

Adding a couple of operational clarifications from the Catalog side so we have a clear ownership map before the call: 

Action items (proposed owners):
- Redwood: architecture diagram (single-pane), security blurb, SOC 2 attestation upload, model/endpoint tags, required sample prompts (owner: Laura).
- MarketWay: GTM description, commercial summary, marketplace pricing tier selection, co-marketing commitments (owner: Julia).
- Joint: listing imagery (logo + screenshots) and customer testimonials — coordinate and approve final assets.

Important note: Marketplaces (esp. GCP) require a manifest CSV with specific column names; I attached a template (catalog_fields.csv) — if MarketWay fills the GTM fields we can merge and validate. Also, to avoid duplicate listings, we need to decide which publisher account publishes the listing; my recommendation is MarketWay publishes the listing and Redwood is listed as the ISV partner. That reduces approval friction on your end.

I'll be on the Tue 11/30 10:00am PT call. Vivek, please confirm if we need to loop in Legal.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Product Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
attachment: catalog_fields.csv (CSV)

From: Julia Myers <julia@marketway.com>

Cc: GCP Partner Ops <gcp-partner-ops@google.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Resale commissioning + Marketplace listing questions (next steps & DocuSign)

Thanks — this is helpful and aligns with Partner Ops' expectation. Quick update after internal review: 

- MarketWay is comfortable with the proposed revshare tiers. For the pilot (Q1) we prefer a 15% flat revshare with an option to rebalance after $250k ARR. Will include this in the term sheet.
- MarketWay will publish the listing (publisher account: MarketWay) and will add Redwood as the ISV partner. We will send the publisher metadata in the catalog_fields.csv format by EOD Monday.
- For support: MarketWay will be first-line; please confirm the severity routing policy and the contact for P1/P2 incidents.

Next steps:
1) Ben — please update the term sheet with the flat 15% pilot option and share a DocuSign link for us to sign.
2) Laura — once we receive the publisher metadata we will submit the GCP manifest and include GCP Partner Ops in the ticket.
3) Vivek/Legal — if any required certification gaps exist, flag them in the drive link and we'll pause listing until cleared.

Forwarding to GCP Partner Ops to request expedited review once manifest is submitted.

Cheers,
Julia
Julia Myers
Head of Partnerships | MarketWay
